mechanism: Within a lookback, find max real or tick volume; normalize each closed bar as width=(vol/maxVol)*InpMaxWidthPct; draw high-low outline plus open-close body as connected rectangles whose horizontal span encodes relative participation while height encodes price range. Prefer real volume when broker volume>0 else tick volume.
data_needed: OHLC + real volume or tick_volume; lookback bars; max width pct; bull/bear colors.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 symbols; InpLookback default 100; chart TF via PeriodSeconds for width→time mapping.
why_new_for_mis: Turns bar-relative volume into a continuous visual/structural participation intensity sensor so MIS can flag high-participation zones without separate volume subplots.
quote: EquiVolume changes the horizontal size of each candle based on trading activity

mechanism: From base close and fixed box size InpPFSize, convert |Δprice|/box into whole boxes; continue X/O column while direction matches; reverse only when opposite move ≥3 boxes; store PF levels and render X/O in a separate window—time is ignored except for spacing.
data_needed: Close series; box size (instrument/TF dependent, e.g. EURUSD 0.0010, XAUUSD 5.0); max PF count; 3-box reversal fixed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY/AUDUSD/USDCAD/XAUUSD suggested box sizes; any chart TF with box retuned.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a pure price-movement regime/reversal sensor that blanks noise below one box and only fires column flips on multi-box reversals.
quote: a reversal is only verified when the price moves at least three boxes in the opposite direction

idea_name: External swing then first internal CHoCH setup
mechanism: Confirm swings with left/right lookback (external=15, internal=3); build S1→S4 bullish sequence; refine EXL/EXH via ArrayMinimum/Maximum between anchors; validate HL/HH; inside intact external range find first IH→IL then candle open<IH close>IH CHoCH; reject if prior internal already fired or EXL/EXH broken; place entry at CHoCH close, SL at IL, TP=1.5R.
data_needed: OHLC; look_back (~1000); EX_SwingLookback; internal lookback 3; intactness checks to CHoCH.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic chart TF; bullish path detailed (bearish inverted).
why_new_for_mis: Two-scale structure regime sensor: external trend frame plus first validated internal momentum shift—usable as a MIS structure-state event.
quote: searches inside that confirmed range for the first IH→IL→CHoCH sequence

idea_name: Rolling Sharpe with Lo SE significance bands
mechanism: Per bar, compute window mean/std of log or simple returns; SR_ann=√N·(mean/σ); SE_ann=√N·√[(1+½ SR_raw²)/n]; plot SR ± z·SE (default z=1.96). Rule: if bands straddle zero, visible Sharpe is noise; else significant at chosen CI. Stateless ComputeBar avoids MT5 partial-history recalc bugs.
data_needed: Close prices; inp_Window (≥~120 on H1 FX); inp_PeriodsPerYear by TF/instrument (H1 FX 8736, D1 equity 252, crypto D1 365); z-score; log vs simple.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 demo (window 60, N=252 shown); calibration table for M1–W1 FX/equity/crypto.
why_new_for_mis: Converts a noisy performance point estimate into a live noise-vs-edge sensor MIS can gate on instead of trusting raw rolling Sharpe.
quote: if the bands straddle zero, the visible Sharpe is statistical noise; if they do not, the Sharpe reading is significant at the chosen confidence level

idea_name: Adaptive Kalman Gain from rolling Q/R
mechanism: Scalar RW Kalman on close: Q_t=var(Δclose,W_Q), R_t=var(close,W_R) with ε floors; predict P+=Q; K=P/(P+R); update state+=K·innovation. Expose K∈[0,1] in Data Window (clrNONE plot). High K→trust measurement (volatile/trending); low K→trust model (noisy range). Benchmarked vs EMA20 on EURUSD H1.
data_needed: Closes; W_Q and W_R (default 20; FX H1 tip W_Q=10,W_R=60); P0; min Q/R floors.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 500-bar MAE/RMSE/lag tests; regime split by ATR threshold.
why_new_for_mis: Kalman Gain is a per-bar measurement-vs-model trust meter that adapts when volatility regimes shift—stronger than fixed-α smoothers for MIS regime-sensitive filtering.
quote: When K_t→1, the filter trusts the raw measurement completely—process noise dominates, the system is volatile and trending. When K_t→0, the filter trusts its own prediction—measurement noise dominates, the system is range-bound and noisy

mechanism: Dual pipelines (internal chart TF + external HTF): swing detect → level tracker (regression-slope trend + hysteresis + protected highs/lows) → break detector (ATR-normalized) → classify BOS vs CHoCH by trend alignment → publish typed events on circular bus with dedupe cache → state machine {BULLISH,BEARISH,TRANSITION,RANGE,UNKNOWN}; CSV persistence and snapshot API for EAs.
data_needed: OHLC + ATR on internal and external TF; swing strengths; external TF (default H4); history windows; optional persistence.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart TF + InpExternalTimeframe PERIOD_H4; tested on >20k bars.
why_new_for_mis: Programmable multi-timeframe structure event stream and discrete market-state label—MIS can consume BOS/CHoCH/STATE_CHANGED without scraping chart objects.
quote: When a CHoCH event arrives, the machine immediately moves to STATE_TRANSITION. A bullish BOS moves it to STATE_BULLISH, and a bearish BOS to STATE_BEARISH

idea_name: OLS t-based CI vs PI regression channels
mechanism: Rolling OLS on closes over grid x=0..n-1; s²=SSE/(n-2); bands use Student-t critical via Cornish-Fisher; CI: ŷ±t·s·√(1/n+(x-x̄)²/Sxx); PI adds +1 under sqrt for observation noise; evaluate at edge x=n-1 or one-step x=n; bands widen by leverage away from x̄—not by thinner data.
data_needed: Closes; regression window (≥5, demo 50); confidence level (0.95); EVAL_CURRENT_EDGE vs EVAL_NEXT_BAR.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 diagnostics and chart figures.
why_new_for_mis: Inferential volatility envelope with nested mean vs observation uncertainty and explicit forecast-edge mode—MIS can treat PI breaches as model-stress events rather than heuristic Bollinger touches.
quote: Price reaching or exceeding a prediction-interval line is the statistically meaningful event

mechanism: Scan lookback closes for R_i=(C_i-C_{i-1})/C_{i-1}·100; bucket into 5×24 Mon–Fri × hour-of-day (drop weekends); Avg=Sum/Count per cell; color by Avg/max|Avg| red↔green via CCanvas. Exploratory only—no significance test.
data_needed: Bar times + closes; lookback (default 5000); chart TF determines hour granularity.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 ~5000 bars (~7 months) fills 120 cells; M1 same lookback leaves many empty cells.
why_new_for_mis: Compact calendar-seasonality sensor of when average returns historically concentrate—MIS can use hour/day cells as session priors or filter hypotheses.
quote: The heatmap computes the average bar return for each hour-of-day and day-of-week over a configurable lookback period

idea_name: Session tick-density POC and 70% Value Area
mechanism: On London/NY/custom session rollover, CopyTicksRange; CFD-safe filter (bid/ask>0, volume weight→1 if no exchange volume); bin by floor((P-session_low)/BinSize); POC=argmax bin volume; greedy expand VA to ≥70% total volume from POC; render histogram + VAH/VAL/POC rays.
data_needed: Session tick stream; bin size in points; VA%; session hours (London 08–17 UTC, NY 13–22 UTC).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: OTC/CFD tick-density profiles; any chart TF with fixed-width bar scaling; XAU-style POC example in diagnostics.
why_new_for_mis: Native session accepted-price liquidity map (POC/VA) without third-party VP tools—MIS can track where transactional effort concentrated last session.
quote: Two sessions can produce identical OHLC values but completely different volume distributions

idea_name: Modified Z-Score OHLCV composite outlier bar sensor
mechanism: On each bar window extract body, upper/lower wick, tick volume; median + MAD per feature; M=0.6745·(x−med)/MAD; composite=mean of |M| across four features; flag mild (>2.5) and strong (>3.5); histogram + chart arrows/boxes. Robust to the outliers it detects.
data_needed: OHLC + tick_volume; rolling window (default 200); mild/strong thresholds.
why_new_for_mis: Multi-feature robust anomaly score that tags statistically contaminated bars before they poison ATR/Bollinger/regime estimates—MIS hygiene and shock sensor.
quote: Averaging rather than taking the maximum means that a bar must be elevated across multiple features to produce a high composite score

mechanism: For each of N historical D1 sessions, take prior day H/L/C: P=(H+L+C)/3; R1=2P−L, S1=2P−H, R2=P+(H−L), S2=P−(H−L), R3=H+2(P−L), S3=L−2(H−P); draw object trendlines per session; recalc on new D1 else only extend today's anchors.
data_needed: D1 H/L/C via iHigh/iLow/iClose; historical session count; chart TF ≤ D1.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol; M1–D1 only; default 15 historical pivot days.
why_new_for_mis: Classic prior-day geometry as a daily reference-level sensor MIS can treat as session magnets for interaction/break monitoring.
quote: the levels P plus R1–R3 and S1–S3 are calculated strictly from the previous day's High/Low/Close values

mechanism: Walkthrough of MetaEditor sampling profiler (Total vs Self CPU, heat map) optimizing a naive rolling z-score via sliding accumulators and prev_calculated. Developer tooling only—no new market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Rolling z-score demo on EURUSD H1.
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—IDE profiling workflow article.
quote: The goal is not this indicator but the profiling workflow
